note.text: Boilerplate exclusion applies to the derived normalized_text only. The compare pane serves the raw filing bytes, so it still shows every page break and running head the extracted pane drops — the two panes will not agree while this is on. There is no raw-to-normalized offset map in this pipeline (ADR-026 §a), so this is a known limit of the compare view, not a fault in either pane.
